ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible surface; low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels are concentrated along the trailing edge and in localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region across both lobes. Dark-pixel focal spots are mapped to the upper-left distal region and upper-right quadrant. A high-contrast horizontal dark marking is located in the lower-central region near the notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 75-85 degrees; depth is approximately 5% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes of 3-7 pixels relative to the lobe's mean curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight concave curvature moving from the median notch towards the lateral tips; tips are sharply tapered and swept slightly upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized circular dark-pixel clusters (5-10 pixels in diameter) are visible, primarily concentrated in the upper-left quadrant of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel horizontal dark-pixel lines located in the lower central region of the right lobe, breaking the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized horizontal scarring in the lower-central region; highly irregular jagged segments along the trailing edge topography suggest previous physical trauma or parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'double-bar' horizontal marking is present in the lower right-central region of the fluke surface.
